notes: Same site, imagery and image points as surkotada__joshi1990-fig8.json; see that file for how the site was located (the published coordinates fall about 8 km west of the excavated site). Fig. 4 is a sketch plan printed sideways, with its north arrow pointing to the left. To match features it was viewed rotated a quarter turn, so that the drawn north arrow points up, and reduced to the imagery scale; plan pixel coordinates above refer to the unrotated render named in plans-v1.json. The closed house rectangle, the gateway rectangle (Entrance IC and Guard rooms) and the platform beside the bastion are the only drawn features that correspond one to one with the exposed remains. The three points form a triangle about 60 m by 70 m; no fourth feature could be identified with confidence.
